entries.source: A mature storm drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
entries.target: 一条成年风暴龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

entries.source: An old and powerful storm drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
entries.target: 一条年长且强大的风暴龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

entries.source: A swarm of midges; they want blood.
You have intruded on their ground, and they will defend it at all costs.
entries.target: 你已经闯入了它们的地盘，它们会不惜一切代价保卫这里。
并使其迷失在时间之外

entries.source: A temporal elemental, rarely encountered except by those who travel through time itself.  Its blurred form constantly shifts before your eyes.
entries.target: 一只时间元素，除了亲身穿越时间的人之外很少有人遇到。它模糊的形态在你眼前不断变幻。

entries.source: Time and space collapse in upon this erratically-moving time elemental.
entries.target: 时空在这只漂泊的时间元素周围不断塌陷。

entries.source: The lowest of the thieves, this cutpurse is just learning the tricks of the trade.
entries.target: 盗贼中最底层的扒手，他正在学习这一行的门道。

entries.source: Stronger than a cutpurse, this thief has been promoted.
entries.target: 比扒手更强，这个盗贼已经晋升了。

entries.source: He eyes you and your belongings, then suddenly vanishes... strange, why is your pack lighter?
entries.target: 他盯着你和你的背包，然后突然消失不见……好奇怪，你的背包似乎轻了许多？

entries.source: These ruffians often employ brute force over thievery, but they are capable of stealing as well.
entries.target: 这些恶棍往往更习惯用蛮力而非偷窃，但他们也同样会偷。

entries.source: He is the leader of a gang of bandits. Watch out for his underlings.
entries.target: 他是这伙强盗的首领，当心他的手下。

entries.source: Before you looms a pair of eyes... a glint of steel... death.
entries.target: 你面前浮现出一双眼睛……一道金属寒光……死亡。

entries.source: Stealthy fighters trying to achieve victory with trickery. Be careful or they will steal your life!
entries.target: 善用诡计取胜的潜行斗士。小心，他们会偷走你的生命！

entries.source: Stealthy tricksters that leave a wake of deadfalls and other hazards.  They really just make a mess of things.
entries.target: 狡猾的骗子，他们会留下死亡陷阱和其他危险的东西。他们真的只会让事态变得糟糕。

entries.source: Green-skinned and ugly, this massive humanoid glares at you, clenching wart-covered green fists.
entries.target: 这只绿皮丑陋的庞大人形生物正盯着你，同时它握紧了满是疣的绿色拳头。

entries.source: A giant troll with scabrous black skin. With a shudder, you notice the belt of dwarf skulls around his massive waist.
entries.target: 一只皮肤粗糙黝黑的巨魔。你注意到他粗壮的腰间系着一条矮人头骨串成的腰带，不禁打了个寒战。

entries.source: This huge troll wields a massive spear and has a disturbingly intelligent look in its piggy eyes.
entries.target: 这只巨魔手握一根笨重的长矛，它那双小猪般的眼睛里透露出一种令人不安的聪明神情。

entries.source: A large and athletic troll with an extremely tough and warty hide.
entries.target: 一只高大且强壮的巨魔，皮肤异常坚韧且长满疣。

entries.source: A disgusting and mismatched construct of necromantically-enhanced troll bits and shattered weapons. Confused and furious, it rends and shatters its surroundings with impossible strength, moving with speed found nowhere in nature.
entries.target: 一个由死灵法术强化的巨魔残肢与碎裂武器拼凑而成的恶心造物。它困惑而暴怒，以不可思议的力量撕裂摧毁周围的一切，移动速度在自然界中无处可寻。

entries.source: This old-looking troll glares at you with malice. His muscles appear atrophied, but a certain power surrounds him nonetheless.
entries.target: 这只老迈的巨魔恶狠狠地盯着你。尽管它已经年老力衰，但是你仍能感受到一股强大的能量环绕着它。

entries.source: A skeletal rat, teeth and claws ground to a sharp point. It glares at you menacingly.
entries.target: 一只骷髅鼠，牙齿和爪子磨得尖利。它充满威胁地瞪着你。

entries.source: Layers of rotting skin are peeling off of this rat. One of the eye sockets appears empty.
entries.target: 斑驳的皮肤从这只老鼠身上脱落，它的一只眼窝空洞的看着你。

entries.source: An eerie haze surrounds this translucent rat.
entries.target: 怪异的烟雾环绕着这只透明的老鼠。

entries.source: Looks much like a normal rat. That is, other than the very large fangs.
entries.target: 除了那对大得出奇的尖牙，它看起来和普通老鼠没什么两样。

entries.source: This massive beast appears to be a rat composed of countless bones fused together.
entries.target: 这只巨大的怪物看起来像是许多骨头拼起来的老鼠。

entries.source: The master of the pit is before you. It squeaks with menace as it and a horde of minions approach you.
entries.target: 深坑的主人就在你面前。它发出威胁性的吱吱声，与一大群爪牙一同向你逼近。

entries.source: #RED#Rising again, the Rat Lich's eyes glow with renewed energy!
entries.target: #RED#鼠巫妖再次复活，它的眼睛放射着全新能量的光辉！
